title: New train 456: Bruxelles Midi to Milano Porta Garibaldi
summary: A new route for train 456 from Bruxelles Midi / Brussel Zuid to Milano Porta Garibaldi has been added. It operates on Mondays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, with a return train 457. The route includes stops at Antwerpen Centraal, Breda, Eindhoven Centraal, Köln Hbf, Aarau, Arth-Goldau, Göschenen, Bellinzona, Lugano, and Como San Giovanni.
